reason: The direct-corner envelope only proves that the corner A_U admits an extended L^0*epsilon-C*-algebra bound; it does not bound the independently recorded epsilon_U field of the already supplied reset state, and there is no hypothesis identifying or rebinding that field to L^0*epsilon. Indeed at epsilon=0 take exact ambient/map/reset data (so d_U=0 and the unit error is 0) but record any epsilon_U>0; all displayed reset inequalities remain true, while epsilon_U<=W.L*epsilon=0 is false. The same unexplained 'corresponding recorded' move affects epsilon_R, which is not even a field of the supplied U-reset state. Thus the theorem's certification cannot be converted into the asserted recorded bounds without an additional hypothesis or an explicit replacement/rebinding construction.
